description: This file defines a 'Sidebar' React component that provides a navigational side menu with collapsible sections, active state highlighting, and links to main pages and admin functions. It uses React hooks and react-router-dom components for routing and UI state management.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Helper function to determine if a given path matches the current URL pathname, used to highlight active links.

methods.name: isAdminActive
methods.description: Helper function to check if the current URL pathname indicates an active admin section.

ctags.name: 5 rounded-lg transition-colors duration-200 ${ isActive('/dashboard') ? 'bg-primary text-white' : 'text-text hover:bg-gray-100' }
5 rounded-lg transition-colors duration-200 ${ isActive('/history') ? 'bg-primary text-white' : 'text-text hover:bg-gray-100' }
5 rounded-lg transition-colors duration-200 ${ isActive('/submit') || isActive('/') ? 'bg-primary text-white' : 'text-text hover:bg-gray-100' }
5 rounded-lg transition-colors duration-200 ${ isAdminActive() ? 'bg-gray-100 text-primary' : 'text-text hover:bg-gray-50' }
